items.text: the new in tele page lists the settings that came with the new build, also for a user who updated from tele 1.
an interrupted update download continues where it stopped, and a failed check waits longer before the next attempt.
a scheduled message that the server delayed is sent on time, with a bounded number of retries.
items.where: settings → tele → sending → send scheduled messages on time

items.text: service messages show their time too, like joins and pins.
items.where: settings → tele → interface → show seconds in message times

items.text: the similar channels block and the request behind it can be turned off.
items.where: settings → tele → interface → hide similar channels

items.text: the tooltip of the collectible status can be hidden.
items.where: settings → tele → interface → hide the collectible status hint

items.text: the animations are limited while the chat is open, and the previous state comes back when the option is turned off.
the edited mark is not shown on the messages of a bot.
items.where: settings → tele → interface → no edited mark on bot messages

items.text: a long tap on the start button shows the start parameter of the bot.
items.where: settings → tele → interface → show the start parameter

items.text: the link rewrite presets follow the new targets: TikTok goes to tnktok.com only, X adds samekosabax.com, and the old vxtiktok.com target is migrated silently.
the phone number can be hidden in the profiles.
items.where: settings → tele → privacy → hide phone numbers in profiles

items.text: the gift button in the message field and the gift entry of a channel can be hidden.
items.where: settings → tele → sending → hide the gift button in the message field

items.text: the copied peer id is the plain number, without the spaces and without the data center.
items.where: profile → the id and data center rows

items.text: the data center of a chat comes from the oldest photo of its avatar history, and the row says uncertain when the data centers differ.
items.where: settings → tele → ids → show data center
